page_title: WHU 0-3 CHE | West Ham v Chelsea 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Carlos Soler (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Shots on target – 7:5.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' Great teamplay by West Ham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
84' Enzo Fernandez goes off the pitch and Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea) comes on.
83' Michail Antonio (West Ham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
82' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
80' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from West Ham.
79' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) prepares to take a corner kick.
77' Max Kilman (West Ham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
76' A header by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) from very close range goes towards the right-hand post, but doesn't get past Alphonse Areola, who makes a brilliant save.
75' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
74' Substitution. Lucas Paqueta leaves the pitch and is replaced by Andrew Irving (West Ham).
73' Julen Lopetegui has decided to make a change. Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) replaces Emerson.
71' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Samuel Barrott and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
69' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) steps up to send the ball in.
66' The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner.
64' Substitution. Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) replaces Nicolas Jackson.
64' Here is a change. Cole Palmer is going off and Enzo Maresca gives the last tactical orders to Joao Felix (Chelsea).
61' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
59' A snap shot by Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola produces a good save to thwart him.
57' Substitution. Jadon Sancho makes his way off the pitch and Pedro Neto (Chelsea) comes on as his replacement.
57' Here's the change. Wesley Fofana leaves the pitch and Axel Disasi (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
54' Julen Lopetegui has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Michail Antonio (West Ham) replacing Crysencio Summerville.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Soler (West Ham) comes onto the pitch for Edson Alvarez.
53' The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.
52' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Yellow card. Edson Alvarez (West Ham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
47' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Tomas Soucek (West Ham).
47' 0 - 3 Goal! Nicolas Jackson passes the ball to the feet of Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:3.
46' The whistle blows and Samuel Barrott starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' There's an opportunity for Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45' What was Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
41' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
41' West Ham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
38' Today's match ends for Guido Rodriguez who will be replaced by Tomas Soucek (West Ham).

37' The ball spins to Noni Madueke (Chelsea) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
35' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
32' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
31' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
31' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

31' Play continues despite the shouts by some West Ham players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
29' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. West Ham are awarded the free kick.
28' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
28' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Robert Sanchez makes a smart save to deny him.
25' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:2.
24' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
23' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away. West Ham win a corner.
21' West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
18' 0 - 2 Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
14' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for an infringement. West Ham get a free kick.
13' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
12' Close! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
11' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

8' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
8' Samuel Barrott couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) and blew his whistle.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and fires the ball past the goalkeeper.
2' Neat passing move from Chelsea in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. West Ham will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will referee today's match.
